summary: JourneyTEAM's ReSkill program, a Business Central consulting talent effort: it finds people with industry experience, teaches them BC technology, and trains consultant and soft skills. The video is a 2-minute BCTalent Stories piece published 2024-04-25.
overview:
JourneyTEAM, a Business Central partner, describes growth of roughly 30 percent or more over the last few years and the difficulty of finding people with the right skill sets. Few people have both BC experience and consultant skills, so the company looked for a new source of talent.

Its answer is ReSkill. The program picks people with industry experience who understand business processes, teaches them BC technology, and builds their consulting skills. It also includes professional skills training on mindset and soft skills, because technologists tend to focus only on technical skills. The speaker reports gains in technical knowledge and in clarity of expectations for how consultants work.
key_points: JourneyTEAM reports growth of roughly 30 percent or more over the last few years and says finding talent with the right skill sets is hard.
The stated problem is that few people have both BC experience and consultant skills.
ReSkill targets people with industry experience who understand business processes, then teaches BC technology and consultant skills.
ReSkill is described as part of JourneyTEAM's growth strategy.
Professional skills training covers mindset and soft skills, which the speaker says technologists often overlook.
Reported results so far: more technical knowledge and clearer expectations of how consultants should work.
The video also says the BC community needs next-generation talent.
